ns2:course.label: Inter Expository Writing
ns2:course.description: Practice in expository types, with emphasis on style and critical analysis. Restricted to rhetoric majors. Credit is not given for both RHET 243 and RHET 233. Prerequisite: Completion of campus Composition I general education requirement.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Credit is not given for both RHET 243 and RHET 233. Prerequisite: Completion of campus Composition I general education requirement.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Rhetoric major(s) or minor(s). Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Priority registration given to Rhetoric and English majors. Especially recommended for students who have some confidence in their handling of the fundamentals of writing.
